sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager (On-Site Position)
sourceEvidence.quote:
1. Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or a related field (equivalent experience considered).

2. 10+ years of QA/QC experience in electrical, utility, power, or heavy industrial construction, with 5+ years in a leadership role.

3. Deep knowledge of high-voltage construction methods and applicable codes/standards (NESC, NEC, IEEE, ANSI, OSHA interfaces).

4. Demonstrated experience building and running a multi-project or enterprise QMS.
